title: Musk floats Amazon rival as AI shopping battle comes into focus
key_facts: Musk replied on X on 15 Oct 2026: "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon."
The exchange began when a user claimed Amazon was blocking Grok Bot agents from placing orders.
Users saw an Amazon message saying continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates its Conditions of Use.
Musk gave no details or plan; Not a Tesla App calls it not a formal announcement.
Amazon told GeekWire it blocked Meta's Muse agent: undisclosed access, no self-identification, apparent storage of customer credentials.
Teslarati: a block was already reported on 10 Oct; Amazon had not commented on Grok Bot.
Teslarati: Musk said SpaceX will reimburse users if Grok Bot errs on a purchase or leaks a card; this is a post on X, not published policy.
quote_evidence: "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon," Musk wrote on X.
Amazon has been tightening its restrictions on third-party AI agents that attempt to shop on its website.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows retailers and agent makers fighting over who controls AI shopping.
notes: Original investing.com article blocked (403); read India Today, Teslarati and Not a Tesla App instead; India Today is the credited outlet and url. Original listed source was investing.com.
